<div class="lake-content">
<p><span class="ne-text">大家好，我是<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/shenchuanchao">码农刚子</a>。</span>本文详细介绍了Blazor框架中的依赖注入机制和状态管理方案。依赖注入部分阐述了服务注册的三种生命周期方式（Singleton/Scoped/Transient）及在组件中的使用方法。状态管理章节系统梳理了7种解决方案：从简单的组件内状态到父子组件通信、级联参数，再到全局状态容器和Flux/Redux模式，并提供了本地存储持久化方案。文章还介绍了@ref指令的使用场景，包括组件引用、元素操作和循环处理等。最后给出了不同场景下的状态管理选择建议，帮助开发者构建更健壮。</p>
<h2 id="IL0DN"><span class="ne-text">一、依赖注入基础</span></h2>
<p id="ud0d0ba14" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Blazor 提供了强大的<strong>依赖注入（Dependency Injection, DI）</strong><span class="ne-text">功能，用于将服务以解耦的方式注入到组件中,<span class="ne-text">它帮助我们实现松耦合的代码设计，提高可测试性和可维护性。</span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="gMIDh"><span class="ne-text">什么是依赖注入？</span></h3>
<p id="u7e1d1c17" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">依赖注入是一种设计模式，它允许类从外部接收其依赖项，而不是自己创建它们。在 Blazor 中，这意味着组件不需要知道如何创建服务，而是通过构造函数或属性接收这些服务。</span></p>
<h2 id="aevIi"><span class="ne-text">二、注册和使用服务</span></h2>
<h3 id="6b4282ec"><span class="ne-text">1、创建自定义服务</span></h3>
<h4 id="lWJ3w"><span class="ne-text">1. 定义服务接口</span></h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ICounterService
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Increment(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> currentValue);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Decrement(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> currentValue);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Reset();
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h4 id="c7olq"><span class="ne-text">2. 实现服务</span></h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CounterService : ICounterService
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Increment(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> currentValue)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> currentValue + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Decrement(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> currentValue)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> currentValue - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Reset()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重置逻辑</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 id="GeCcy"><span class="ne-text">2、注册服务</span></h3>
<p id="u40c2604b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在&nbsp;<code>Program.cs&nbsp;</code><span class="ne-text">文件中配置服务容器：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> builder =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WebAssemblyHostBuilder.CreateDefault(args);
builder.RootComponents.Add</span>&lt;App&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#app</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注册服务</span>
builder.Services.AddSingleton&lt;ICounterService, CounterService&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
builder.Services.AddScoped</span>&lt;IUserService, UserService&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
builder.Services.AddTransient</span>&lt;IEmailService, EmailService&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注册内置服务</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">builder.Services.AddLocalStorage();
builder.Services.AddAuthorizationCore();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> builder.Build().RunAsync();</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="72c9af30"><span class="ne-text">3、服务生命周期</span></h3>
<p id="u739ec356" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Blazor 支持三种服务生命周期：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u58c0a466" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><strong><span class="ne-text">Singleton</span></strong></code><span class="ne-text">：整个应用生命周期内只有一个实例</span></li>
<li id="u7f728ac6" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><strong><span class="ne-text">Scoped</span></strong></code><span class="ne-text">：每个用户会话有一个实例（Blazor Server）或每个浏览器标签页（Blazor WebAssembly）</span></li>
<li id="uc969bf7e" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><strong><span class="ne-text">Transient</span></strong></code><span class="ne-text">：每次请求时创建新实例</span></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="C0wP7"><span class="ne-text">4、在组件中使用依赖注入</span></h3>
<h4 id="xdHKF">1. 使用&nbsp;<code>[Inject]</code>&nbsp;特性</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@page <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/counter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
@inject ICounterService CounterService
 
</span>&lt;h3&gt;Counter&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Current count: @currentCount&lt;/p&gt;
 
&lt;button <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">btn btn-primary</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">IncrementCount</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;Click me&lt;/button&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> currentCount = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IncrementCount()
    {
        currentCount </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CounterService.Increment(currentCount);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h4 id="SkTL0"><span class="ne-text">2. 在代码中使用注入的服务</span></h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@page <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/user-profile</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
@inject IUserService UserService
@inject NavigationManager Navigation

</span>&lt;h3&gt;User Profile&lt;/h3&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

@if (user </span>!= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
{
    </span>&lt;div&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;Name: @user.Name&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;Email: @user.Email&lt;/p&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}

@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> User user;
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        user </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task UpdateProfile()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserService.UpdateUserAsync(user);
        Navigation.NavigateTo(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/success</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 id="LplXQ"><span class="ne-text">5、<span class="ne-text">高级依赖注入用法</span></span></h3>
<h4 id="iSssC"><span class="ne-text">1. 工厂模式注册</span></h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>builder.Services.AddSingleton&lt;ICounterService&gt;(provider =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 复杂的创建逻辑</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CounterService();
});</span></pre>
</div>
<h4 id="oetvp"><span class="ne-text">2. 选项模式</span></h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置选项类</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApiOptions
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> BaseUrl { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> TimeoutSeconds { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注册选项</span>
builder.Services.Configure&lt;ApiOptions&gt;(options =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    options.BaseUrl </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://api.example.com</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    options.TimeoutSeconds </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
});

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 在服务中使用</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApiService
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApiOptions _options;
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> ApiService(IOptions&lt;ApiOptions&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> options)
    {
        _options </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> options.Value;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h4 id="aquvH"><span class="ne-text">3. 条件注册</span></h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#if</span> DEBUG<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
builder.Services.AddSingleton</span>&lt;ILogger, DebugLogger&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
builder.Services.AddSingleton</span>&lt;ILogger, ProductionLogger&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#endif</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 id="mKhjG"><span class="ne-text">三、组件状态管理</span></h2>
<p id="u3bacfa99" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在Blazor开发中，状态管理是构建交互式Web应用的核心挑战。无论是简单的计数器组件还是复杂的实时协作系统，选择合适的状态管理方案直接影响应用性能和可维护性。</span></p>
<h3 id="pAHHU"><span class="ne-text">1、理解Blazor中的状态管理</span></h3>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ueba0088f" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">状态是指应用程序或组件在某一时刻的数据或信息。例如，一个计数器组件可以有一个表示当前计数值的状态，一个表单组件可以有一个表示用户输入的状态，一个购物车组件可以有一个表示选中商品的状态等。状态管理是指如何存储、更新、获取和传递这些数据或信息。</span></li>
<li id="u5dbb173d" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">在Blazor中，每个组件都有自己的私有状态，它只能被该组件访问和修改。如果要将状态从一个组件传递给另一个组件，或者在多个组件之间共享状态，就需要使用一些技术或模式来实现。下面我们将介绍一些常见的方法。</span></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="736d4220"><span class="ne-text">2、组件内状态：最简单的状态管理</span></h3>
<p id="u6738d203" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Blazor组件最基础的状态管理方式是使用组件内部的字段或属性保存状态。这种模式适用于状态仅在单个组件内部使用且无需共享的场景，如计数器、表单输入等基础交互。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@page <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/counter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

&lt;h1&gt;Counter&lt;/h1&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Current count: @currentCount&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;button <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">btn btn-primary</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">IncrementCount</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;Click me&lt;/button&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> currentCount = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IncrementCount()
    {
        currentCount</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p id="uf81a1097" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">上述代码展示了典型的组件内状态模式，<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">currentCount</span></code><span class="ne-text">字段存储计数器状态，<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">IncrementCount</span></code><span class="ne-text">方法修改状态并自动触发UI重新渲染。这种模式的优势在于实现简单、零外部依赖，适合快速开发独立功能组件。</span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="45b3ebdf"><span class="ne-text">3、父子组件通信：参数和事件回调</span></h3>
<p id="uaefceb71" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果要将父组件的状态传递给子组件，或者从子组件获取更新后的状态，可以使用<strong><span class="ne-text">参数</span></strong><span class="ne-text">和<strong><span class="ne-text">属性</span></strong><span class="ne-text">来实现。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="uf93b9d70" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">参数</span></strong><span class="ne-text">是指父组件向子组件传递数据或信息的方式。参数可以是任意类型的值，例如字符串、数字、布尔值、对象、委托等。要定义一个参数，需要在子组件中使用<code>[Parameter]</code>特性来标记一个公共属性，并且该属性的类型必须与父组件传递的值相同。例如：</span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text"><span class="ne-text"><span class="ne-text">这样就定义了一个名为<code>Counter</code>的参数，在子组件中可以使用以下语法来获取它的值：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;p&gt;The counter value <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> @Counter&lt;/p&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p id="u2768ad04" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在父组件中，可以使用以下语法来为参数赋值：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;CounterComponent Counter=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@currentCount</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> currentCount = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这样就将父组件中的变量currentCount作为参数值传递给了子组件。如果要实现从父到子单向绑定。</p>
<p>属性是指子组件向父组件传递数据或信息的方式。属性可以是任意类型的值，但通常是一个事件回调（EventCallback）或一个动作（Action），用于在子组件中触发父组件定义的一个方法，从而将数据或信息传递给父组件。要定义一个属性，需要在子组件中使用[Parameter]特性来标记一个公共属性，并且该属性的类型必须是EventCallback&lt;T&gt;或Action&lt;T&gt;，其中T是要传递的数据或信息的类型。例如：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;h3&gt;CounterComponent&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;The counter value <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> @Counter&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;button @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CounterChangedFromChild</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;Update Counter <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> Child&lt;/button&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
@code {
    [Parameter]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Counter { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
 
    [Parameter]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> EventCallback&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt; OnCounterChanged { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task CounterChangedFromChild()
    {
        Counter</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnCounterChanged.InvokeAsync(Counter);    
    }
 
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>以上例子中就定义了一个名为<code>OnCounterChanged</code>的属性，将子组件中的变量<code>Counter</code>作为参数传递给了父组件。在父组件中，可以使用以下语法来为属性赋值：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;CounterComponent OnCounterChanged=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HandleCounterChanged</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p>这样就将父组件中定义的一个方法名作为属性值传递给了子组件。该方法必须接受一个与属性类型相同的参数，并且可以在其中处理数据或信息。例如：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@code{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> HandleCounterChanged(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> counter)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">The counter value is {counter}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这样就实现了从子到父单向传递数据或信息，并且可以在任何时候触发。</p>
<p>使用组件参数和属性传递状态：适合父子组件之间的简单状态传递，可以使用[Parameter]或者级联参数[CascadingParameter]特性来标记组件参数，并且使用&lt;Component Parameter="Value" /&gt;或者&lt;CascadingValue Value="Value"&gt;&lt;Component /&gt;&lt;/CascadingValue&gt;语法来传递状态。</p>
<h3 id="ygk50">4、级联参数和值</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;!-- AppStateProvider.razor --&gt;
&lt;CascadingValue Value=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    @ChildContent
</span>&lt;/CascadingValue&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

<h3 id="VbJ3N">6、<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="Flux" data-pretit="flux">Flux/Redux 模式</span></h3>
<h4>什么是Flux模式？</h4>
<p>Flux是一种应用程序架构模式，专门用于管理前端应用中的状态。与常见的MVC模式不同，Flux采用单向数据流的设计，使得状态变化更加可预测和易于追踪。</p>
<p>Flux模式的核心思想是将状态管理与UI渲染分离，通过严格的规则来规范状态变更的过程。这种模式最初由Facebook提出，后来被Redux等库实现，而Fluxor则是专门为Blazor应用设计的实现方案。</p>
<h4>Flux模式的核心原则</h4>
<div class="lake-content"><ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u5296e190" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong>状态只读原则</strong></li>
</ol>
<p id="ubf6ff83a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">应用的状态在任何情况下都不应该被直接修改，这保证了状态变更的可控性。</span></p>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="2">
<li id="u7bd489d1" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong>动作驱动变更</strong></li>
</ol>
<p id="u5365666f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">任何状态变更都必须通过派发(dispatch)一个动作(action)来触发。动作是一个简单的对象，描述了发生了什么变化。</span></p>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="3">
<li id="u4947e033" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong>纯函数处理</strong></li>
</ol>
<p id="ubfe4ca9d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">使用称为"reducer"的纯函数来处理动作，根据当前状态和动作生成新状态。Reducer不会修改原有状态，而是返回全新的状态对象。</span></p>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="4">
<li id="uc8307da8" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong>单向数据流</strong></li>
</ol>
<p id="u55bc8c5f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">UI组件订阅状态变化，当状态更新时自动重新渲染。用户交互则通过派发动作来触发状态变更，形成完整的单向循环。</span></p>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<h4 id="epFoq"><span class="ne-text">核心概念</span></h4>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ufcd9a0bc" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">‌<strong><span class="ne-text">状态（State）</span></strong><span class="ne-text">‌：定义应用数据模型，不可直接修改，需通过动作（Action）触发更新。</span></span></li>
<li id="uaa64c922" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">‌<strong><span class="ne-text">动作（Action）</span></strong><span class="ne-text">‌：描述状态变更意图的对象，包含类型标识和有效载荷。</span></span></li>
<li id="u0f441e4f" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">‌<strong><span class="ne-text">归约器（Reducer）</span></strong><span class="ne-text">‌：纯函数，根据当前状态和动作生成新状态。</span></span></li>
<li id="ub47413e1" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">‌<strong><span class="ne-text">效果（Effect）</span></strong><span class="ne-text">‌：处理副作用操作（如 API 调用），监听动作并执行异步任务。</span></span></li>
<li id="uebf66d3f" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">中间件(Middleware)</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：<span class="ne-text">中间件可以在动作被派发到reducer之前或之后执行自定义逻辑，用于日志记录、性能监控等横切关注点。</span></span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<h4>使用 Fluxor 库</h4>
<p>首先安装 Fluxor：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Install-Package Fluxor.Blazor.Web</pre>
</div>
<h4 id="3c8173e4">定义状态和动作</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Store/CounterState.cs</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> record CounterState
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Count { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; init; }
}
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Store/Actions/IncrementCounterAction.cs</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> record IncrementCounterAction;
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Store/Reducers/CounterReducers.cs</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CounterReducers
{
    [ReducerMethod]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CounterState OnIncrementCounter(CounterState state, IncrementCounterAction action)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> state with { Count = state.Count + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h4 id="PAn0L">在组件中使用</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@using Fluxor
@inherits Fluxor.Blazor.Web.Components.FluxorComponent
 
</span>&lt;h3&gt;计数器: @State.Value.Count&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;button @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Increment</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;增加&lt;/button&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
@code {
    [Inject]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> IState&lt;CounterState&gt; State { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
 
    [Inject]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> IDispatcher Dispatcher { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Increment()
    {
        Dispatcher.Dispatch(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IncrementCounterAction());
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 id="SoNxP">7、本地存储持久化</h3>
<h4 id="kJwf1">使用 Blazor 本地存储</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@page <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/counter2</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
@inject IJSRuntime JSRuntime
 
</span>&lt;h3&gt;持久化计数器: @count&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;button @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Increment</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;增加并保存&lt;/button&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> count = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> isInitialized = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task OnAfterRenderAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> firstRender)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (firstRender)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LoadFromStorage();
            isInitialized </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            StateHasChanged(); </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 确保在加载后更新UI</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
    }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task Increment()
    {
        count</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SaveToStorage();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">StateHasChanged();</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task SaveToStorage()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (isInitialized)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">localStorage.setItem</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">counter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, count);
        }
    }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task LoadFromStorage()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> savedCount = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> JSRuntime.InvokeAsync&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">localStorage.getItem</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">counter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.TryParse(savedCount, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result))
            {
                count </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result;
            }
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception ex)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理预渲染期间的 JS 互操作错误</span>
            Console.WriteLine($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">加载存储时出错: {ex.Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
    }
 
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 id="IRHaV">8、状态管理选择指南</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1466017/202510/1466017-20251029095418752-698513023.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="Dtsho">四、使用&nbsp;<code>@ref</code>&nbsp;引用组件</h2>
<p id="u2304e56c">在 Blazor 中，<code>@ref</code>&nbsp;指令用于获取对组件或 HTML 元素的引用，让你能够在代码中直接操作它们。以下是详细的使用方法：</p>
<h3 id="d0mJc">1、引用组件</h3>
<p id="u589e9e09">基本用法</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;!-- MyComponent.razor --&gt;
&lt;h3&gt;计数器: @count&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;button @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Increment</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;增加&lt;/button&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> count = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Increment()
    {
        count</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        StateHasChanged();
    }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Reset()
    {
        count </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        StateHasChanged();
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;!-- ParentComponent.razor --&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
@page </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/parent</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
 
&lt;MyComponent @ref=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">myComponentRef</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
&lt;button @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ResetChild</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;重置子组件&lt;/button&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> MyComponent?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> myComponentRef;
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ResetChild()
    {
        myComponentRef</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Reset();
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 id="jFohx">2、引用 HTML 元素</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@page <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/element-ref</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
 
&lt;input @ref=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">usernameInput</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> placeholder=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">输入用户名</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
&lt;button @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">FocusInput</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;聚焦输入框&lt;/button&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ElementReference usernameInput;
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task FocusInput()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> usernameInput.FocusAsync();
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 id="BTzQF">3、在循环中使用 @ref</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@page <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/loop-ref-example</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
 
&lt;h3&gt;循环中使用 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span> 示例&lt;/h3&gt;
 
&lt;button @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ShowAllMessages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">btn btn-primary</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;显示所有消息&lt;/button&gt;
&lt;button @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">UpdateAllMessages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">btn btn-secondary</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;更新所有消息&lt;/button&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
@foreach (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> item <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> items)
{
    </span>&lt;ChildComponent @ref=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">componentRefs[item.Id]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                    Id</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">item.Id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                    Message</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@item.Message</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                    OnMessageChanged</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HandleMessageChanged</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}
 
@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> List&lt;ItemModel&gt; items = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, ChildComponent?&gt; componentRefs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnInitialized()
    {
        items </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;ItemModel&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ItemModel { Id = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, Message = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">第一条消息</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ItemModel { Id = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, Message = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">第二条消息</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ItemModel { Id = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, Message = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">第三条消息</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
        };
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 预先初始化字典</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> item <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> items)
        {
            componentRefs[item.Id] </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ShowAllMessages()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> component <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> componentRefs.Values)
        {
            component</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.ShowCurrentMessage();
        }
    }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UpdateAllMessages()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> item <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> items)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (componentRefs.TryGetValue(item.Id, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> component) &amp;&amp; component != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                component.UpdateMessage($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">更新后的消息 {item.Id}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
        }
    }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> HandleMessageChanged((<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Id, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Message) data)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">收到消息更新 - ID: {data.Id}, 消息: {data.Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> item = items.FirstOrDefault(i =&gt; i.Id ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data.Id);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (item != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            item.Message </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data.Message;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ItemModel
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Message { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Empty;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;!-- ChildComponent.razor --&gt;
&lt;div <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">child-component</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
    &lt;h5&gt;子组件 ID: @Id&lt;/h5&gt;
    &lt;p&gt;当前消息: &lt;strong&gt;@Message&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
    &lt;input @bind=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">currentMessage</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> @bind:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">event</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">oninput</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
    &lt;button @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">UpdateMessage</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">btn btn-sm btn-info</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;更新消息&lt;/button&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
@code {
    [Parameter]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
 
    [Parameter]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Message { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Empty;
 
    [Parameter]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> EventCallback&lt;(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Id, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Message)&gt; OnMessageChanged { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> currentMessage = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Empty;
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnParametersSet()
    {
        currentMessage </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Message;
    }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task UpdateMessage()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnMessageChanged.InvokeAsync((Id, currentMessage));
    }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ShowCurrentMessage()
    {
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">组件 {Id} 的消息: {Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> UpdateMessage(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> newMessage)
    {
        currentMessage </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> newMessage;
        UpdateMessage().Wait();
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 id="xYYIY">4、使用 ref 回调</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;CustomInput @ref=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SetInputRef</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> CustomInput?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> inputRef;
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SetInputRef(CustomInput component)
    {
        inputRef </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> component;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 组件引用设置后的初始化逻辑</span>
        component?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Initialize();
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 id="sbFl2">5、与 JavaScript 互操作</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@inject IJSRuntime JSRuntime
 
</span>&lt;div @ref=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">myDiv</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> style=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">width: 100px; height: 100px; background: red;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
&lt;button @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ChangeDivStyle</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;修改样式&lt;/button&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ElementReference myDiv;
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task ChangeDivStyle()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">changeElementStyle</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, myDiv);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>对应的 JavaScript 文件：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> wwwroot/js/site.js</span>
window.changeElementStyle = (element) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    element.style.background </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">blue</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    element.style.width </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">200px</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
};</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="ne-quote">
<blockquote>
<p id="ua14c55aa" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">本章节中用到：IJSRuntime ，后面会详细讲解。</span></p>
</blockquote>
